g.title: spec_phase
g.text: Spec-phase tail: drafted requirements to first action

g.title: falsifiers
g.text: name the mechanism that observes each

g.title: review
g.text: and requirements no mechanism can check

g.title: commitment
g.text: Write roadmap section: Agreed requirements, delivery, done-when;
move Current: in the recoverable start transaction

g.title: declare
g.text: cairn declare for this commitment only;
each mechanism has a failing violating example

g.title: authorize
g.text: State what would be bound and ask; on ok
cairn authorize --quote: one record binding the final spec,
(changes or a question: authorize instead | ask, binds nothing)

g.title: startintent
g.text: cairn start: verify authorization and write command intent;
commit the prepared contract, agreement and mechanisms

g.title: startrec
g.text: Finish the start transaction: workspace snapshot plus frozen
set and digests; include from_superseded when resuming;
install exact refspecs when authority remote is configured

g.title: done
g.text: Done: wake names the first work-loop action;
Consequential decisions wait in the queue
